description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Skullwinder
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Skullwinder
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
